name: p4-native
description: The host layer of ezexe/p4: at a session's start it works out what this host is and can do, the desktop app or a terminal, interactive or scripted, the Claude Code version and the tools that answer here, and keeps that map in the project's .claude/p4 store, where the session and the other p4 plugins read it, and when the Claude Code version changes it probes each condition that blocked a decision and tells the session once what changed.
